narrationTexts: Confirms it: only `order totals` fails (3 cases), and only the rows where both discount% and tax rate are non-zero — exactly what the bug hint in `orderTotal`'s comment points at. The tax is being computed on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
All 625 cases pass now.

The bug was in `orderTotal` (`src/pricing.js`): tax was calculated on the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount, contradicting the function's own comment ("tax is charged on the amount the customer pays"). Fixed by computing tax on `discounted` instead of the original `cents`. Only the "order totals" suite was failing (3/625 cases) — everything else was already green, just buried in the verbose output.
